name: Live Wire Solar
old_description: After the design has been finalized, it will be put in place by our installation experts who have been installing solar since 2009, with the combined experience of hundreds of completed solar installations.
about:
Live Wire Solar, operating as Live Wire Electrical Services LLC, is a family-owned electrical contracting and solar installation company based in Ham Lake, Minnesota, within the Twin Cities metro area. The business traces its roots to 2000 when it began as an electrical contractor, adding solar photovoltaic installation in 2009. The company remains locally owned and operated, distinguishing itself from out-of-state sales firms.

The firm functions as a full-service EPC solar contractor, handling design, permitting, installation, and commissioning of solar PV systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural clients. Its scope extends to Level 2 EV charger installation, battery energy storage systems (as a certified LG installer), backup generator consultation and installation, and ongoing system monitoring. The team also assists customers with navigating tax credits, utility rebates, grants, and financing options.

Live Wire serves homeowners, businesses, and farms across Minnesota and western Wisconsin. Projects range from rooftop arrays to ground-mounted installations, with the company citing work for residential customers, commercial properties, and agricultural operations. The company's portfolio includes installations for clients seeking to reduce carbon emissions and energy costs, supported by incentive programs such as the federal ITC, USDA REAP grants, and utility-specific rebates.

Founded on a mission to accelerate renewable energy adoption, Live Wire emphasizes local presence, NABCEP-certified installers, and a licensed, bonded, and insured operation. The company highlights its ability to tailor designs to specific roof layouts and aesthetic requirements, as well as its responsiveness during supply-chain disruptions, as factors that set it apart.
